text:
Overall score: **5/10**.

This is not a disaster: the package is small, mostly readable, and has some meaningful unit tests. But I would not approve it as-is. The biggest problems are reproducibility and runtime readiness: the story dataset is absent, `generate-stories` cannot bootstrap it, generated outputs are present despite being ignored, dependencies are broad/unlocked, and several edge cases would silently produce stale, invalid, or misleading results.

I could not run the test suite successfully in the current environment because required dependencies are missing (`numpy`, `PyYAML`, etc.). Syntax compilation passed when bytecode output was redirected to `/tmp`.

Estimated significant rewrite/change: **420 LOC**.

issues.description: generate-stories requires an existing story manifest, so an empty data/stories directory cannot be bootstrapped.
Configured story dataset is absent, so extraction and demo runs cannot work from a fresh checkout.
Manifest loading has no fallback or helpful recovery path despite being required by story generation.
Story file reads are unvalidated and fail with raw FileNotFoundError instead of reporting missing dataset cells.
parse_story_block treats preamble text before the first delimiter as a story, corrupting generated datasets.
External HTTP story generation has no timeout or robust error handling and can hang indefinitely.
Providing only hf_model or only tokenizer silently discards the supplied object and reloads both from Hugging Face.
from_pretrained uses dtype with a broad transformers lower bound, creating compatibility risk with older supported versions.
all_token_activations materializes all hidden states for all neutral tokens, risking large CPU memory spikes.
emotion_vectors silently produces NaNs when any configured emotion has zero loaded examples.
pca_components does not handle zero-variance input and can divide by zero or return invalid ratios.
load_vectors accepts stale artifacts without checking manifest compatibility with the current config or model.
Validation trusts whatever projected vectors are on disk and can report results for a different run/config.
n_steered_emotions is not bounded, so oversized config values can duplicate selected emotions and overwrite outputs.
Mean shift calculations assume both steered and control groups are non-empty and can emit NaN for valid-looking configs.
Scenario summary assumes at least two emotions; a one-emotion config yields an empty off-diagonal mean.
Importing the package mutates global environment variables, which is surprising for library consumers.
Core ML dependencies are broad minimums with no lock file, making results and runtime behavior non-reproducible.
requirements.txt duplicates unpinned dependencies and mixes runtime and dev requirements.
Integration test requires the gated real model and external credentials, so it is not reliably runnable in CI.
Story dataset tests are skipped when data is missing, allowing the repo's most important missing artifact to pass unnoticed.
Generated egg-info and outputs are ignored but present in the working tree, indicating stale generated artifacts in the codebase.
Generated vector artifacts are present without the source story data needed to reproduce them.
Documented demo commands imply a runnable checkout, but the required stories and gated model setup make that false by default.
